game_title: Condition Builder – Ore Vein Depths Trial
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Ore Vein Depths, a rich ore vein: the cave miner must handle shadow wraiths while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Condition Builder: Choose the loop condition so the loop runs exactly the requested number of times.
theme: Shadow Cave – Ore Vein Depths: a rich ore vein
core_gameplay_loop: In Ore Vein Depths, repeat each round: Choose the loop condition so the loop runs exactly the requested number of times. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the loop_runs value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the cave gate using at most 11 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The cave gate reached with actions_used <= 11.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 11 before the cave gate is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 2 (intro tier): Condition Builder
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how loop_runs changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against shadow wraiths in Ore Vein Depths.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The cave gate reached with actions_used <= 11.
